content: TACO 4th edition (NEPA/UNICAMP, 2011) has 597 foods with values per 100g in BOTH kcal and kJ columns plus a 'Medida caseira' column giving grams per household measure (colher de sopa, xicara, unidade). TBCA (USP) is a maintained alternative also presenting household measures. Structured GitHub datasets of TACO exist for seeding a catalog. Parsing risks: decimal comma, encoding, picking kJ column as kcal, and raw-vs-cooked entries being separate rows.
